title: Retain measured OOM pass elimination and qualify cache headroom experimentally
question: Can fewer payload passes and conservative cache-aware admission improve complete jobs under real memory pressure?
summary: Unmerged opt-in implementation: count-first plain UTF8 Balanced improves 12.09% at2GiB warm; terminal Uniform→Balanced improves3.13% with~44% fewer managed temporary writes. Under a dedicated1GiB/no-swap scope Chopper beats the measured naive DuckDB and composed qsv adapters. Cache credit remains an estimate, decoder throughput is unproven and compact second-pass emitter was rejected.

workloads: 2GiB four-column line-free CSV,8,388,608 rows; warm8-worker native pairs, and cold-input dedicated1GiB cgroup/no-swap,256MiB/one-worker constrained comparisons. Separate497MiB three-column and67MiB33-column screens.

validation.summary: Linux default/all-feature lint/tests, formatting and portable-core all-feature WASM passed; native Windows all-feature lint/tests passed on fresh NTFS snapshot; browser prototype core/full graph/bridge/cleanup and restored default small graph passed. Not entire hosted acceptance suite.

limitations: Experimental opt-in unmerged changes, not released defaults. Cache credit cannot guarantee reclaimability; reservations are not RSS caps.

Three runs per variant, independent cohorts not pooled; qsv composition qualified only for line-free divisible fixture and includes two concurrent pipe commands. DuckDB adapter is not best-known general SQL.
Managed temporary counters exclude private output staging; not physical I/O or total disk peaks. WSL backing cache uncontrolled; no Windows/browser throughput claims.

Original benchmark binaries predate minor error/eligibility refinements; refined correctness receipts are separate. Raw artifacts/runner logs remain local unarchived; derived projection removes checkout-root prefixes.
Historical archive hydration blocks complete generated catalog/registry/views refresh.
exclusions: Warmups, screening/calibration cohorts and failed attempts excluded from confirmation timing populations.
DuckDB256MiB single-COPY variants failed internal OOM and are not throughput observations.
Sync diagnostic and hot digest/random-key components do not establish removable whole-job speedups.
reopen_when: Test isolated native plain512KiB publication buffer and checked serializer fit path with bounded paired complete jobs and admission/publication controls; then expand to all supported operation families in issue20. No automatic promotion.
